carmen.sales: Handoff: Polaris Biotech closed (Dedicated + Private VPC). 12mo term. Procurement signaled a likely renewal discussion at month 9. Please take ownership of onboarding and surface renewal risk.
ioana.cs: Thx Carmen. Drop SSO, CIDRs, and primary tech contact. Any compliance needs?
carmen.sales: Tech contact is infra@polaris.bio. Req: SAML + SCIM, customer-managed KMS, strict audit logs, and an export webhook. DPA attached in ticket SF-9420. Procurement note: may request a mid-term discount review at month 9.
ravi.enablement: I'll lead enablement. Proposed 3-week runway: week0 infra/provision, week1 SSO + SCIM, week2 evals & perf tuning. Will publish runbook and acceptance criteria.
mike.support: I'll scope infra work. Please create support ticket with CIDRs, KMS ARN, SAML metadata, and expected token profile. Need webhook cert details if mTLS.
carmen.sales: Created SF-9420, uploaded CIDRs, contract clip, and initial SAML metadata: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SF-9420
lina.successops: I'll own account health tracking and renewal cadence. Recommend weekly check-ins until go-live, then biweekly. Flagging renewal risk tags: "procurement-review" and "discount-requested".
ioana.cs: Owners & next steps: 1) ravi: onboarding runbook + acceptance checklist (48h) 2) mike: scope SF-9420 infra items & ETA (48h) 3) lina: create renewal-risk note + dashboard tile (72h) 4) carmen: provide SAML final XML + SCIM test user (ASAP).
ravi.enablement: Starting runbook now. Small checklist snippet: ```- Provision VPC peering & routes
- Request customer KMS access & run encrypt/decrypt test
- Deploy private model image: redwood-enterprise-v1
- Configure SAML + SCIM test user sync
- Run perf smoke: 4k tokens across 20 concurrent sessions```
mike.support: Pulled SF-9420. Added infra checklist and tentative ETA of 3-5 business days pending KMS ARN and SAML cert. Will update ticket with ETA.
carmen.sales: Pasted full SAML XML and SCIM test user into the ticket; security contact security@polaris.bio.
lina.successops: I'll stub dashboard tiles for token usage, error rate, and eval-pass rate. Scheduling weekly syncs during onboarding and tagging survey links in the ticket for feedback.
ioana.cs: Capture enablement feedback via the short survey after kickoff and link responses to SF-9420. I'll send kickoff invite for next Tue and keep updates here. Ping me for urgent blockers. :calendar: 
ops-bot: onboarding-playbook v4 applied to Polaris workspace.
